findings.description: Recommendation for fixing button roles (Priority 3) is generic – it does not reference a selector, page URL or count from the audit.
Recommendation to add iframe title attributes (Priority 4) lacks any specific element selector or data anchor.
Contrast‑improvement recommendation (Priority 5) is phrased generically without a CSS selector, page URL or count.
Presentation‑role recommendation (Priority 6) does not include any specific element reference or audit data point.
Pipeline survivability improvement (Priority 7) is stated in abstract terms without a concrete selector, page URL or count.
Optional enhancement to add Content‑Signal directives in robots.txt names only the domain concept; no specific element or data anchor is cited.
Next‑steps suggestion “Consider optional enhancements” is a generic, copy‑paste recommendation with no audit‑specific reference.
Recommendation to serve content variants under distinct URLs or provide a machine‑readable canonical indicator lacks any specific selector, page URL or count from the audit.
